events.headline: Training against reward-hacking monitors works, but models learn to evade them
events.summary: The authors open-source three environments where Qwen3-4B reward hacks and find that models can learn to evade highly accurate monitors by exploiting flaws in probes and LLM judges. Monitors that leak more learning signal suppress hacking…

events.headline: PC-Dr.DPO makes test-time RL more conservative on prompts with unreliable majority votes
events.summary: The paper decomposes majority-vote pseudo-label error in test-time RL into population-majority bias and finite-rollout variation, and proposes PC-Dr.DPO plus a cache to reduce forgetting. Across six reasoning benchmarks and five backbones…

events.headline: MemoryDojo: every agent memory system tested is susceptible to poisoning
events.summary: The benchmark has 155 multi-session trajectories across four domains and supports five memory systems. All memory systems proved susceptible to poisoning, with substantial variation in downstream effects; a memory-aware poison optimization…

events.headline: BitDecoding-FP4 runs the KV cache natively in 4-bit and reports 2.4–3.0× serving throughput
events.summary: An algorithm–system co-design for FP4 KV-cache decoding stays within 0.5 points of BF16 KV accuracy with NVFP4 (1 point with MXFP4). On NVIDIA B300 with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-30B-A3B it reports 2.4–3.0× higher peak serving throughput than BF1…

events.headline: A causal framework estimates when verifying or screening an agent mid-trajectory actually helps
events.summary: The paper builds a framework to estimate the dynamic causal effect of randomized interventions within agent trajectories, using a small dataset collected under randomization. On tau-bench Retail, ToolSandbox and ImpossibleBench, interventi…

events.headline: Zyphra's hierarchical attention builds a tree over the KV cache for subquadratic long-context attention
events.summary: ZHA routes queries top-down through a tree of compressed key summaries, and can be applied to pretrained models with a short KL distillation over a few billion tokens while keeping long-context retrieval, reasoning, math and agentic coding…

events.headline: Stochastic environments can speed up plasticity loss in RL, and TD instability takes over in the hardest settings
events.summary: Training SAC on three DeepMind Control tasks with controlled noise, plasticity-preserving methods improved robustness on the two harder tasks; resets plus layer normalization underperformed resets alone at every noise level tested.

events.headline: Looping a trained model pays for its extra compute only at small scale, a Qwen study finds
events.summary: Across Qwen3 and Qwen3.5 models from 0.8B to 9B parameters, adding loops after training beat both baselines only for the 0.8B model; at 4B and 9B it failed to beat an equal-parameter model.

events.headline: Joint scaling of critic and teacher, plus a step-aware critic, stabilizes few-step distillation
events.summary: In Distribution Matching Distillation, a larger teacher with a small fixed critic can lower student quality and cause collapse; growing the critic with the teacher prevented that, and a step-aware critic (STAC) further helps across ImageNe…

events.headline: Exact worst-case analysis gives optimal, monotonically decreasing SGD stepsizes for smooth convex problems
events.summary: For dimension d ≥ N+1, the paper gives an exact worst-case analysis of the final iterate over any N stepsizes in [0, 1.5]^N; when the variance bound is at least Ω(1/√N), the minimax-optimal schedule is unique and decreasing.

events.headline: CRoS rewards reasoning models for depending on step order, lifting out-of-domain accuracy and faithfulness
events.summary: Shuffling reasoning steps without changing their content gives a causal-reliance reward; with Gemma-3-4B on Reasoning Gym it reaches 46.8% on five unseen datasets versus 43.8% for the best baseline, and 34.0% hint acknowledgment versus 20.…

events.headline: TopKLoRA's sparse adapters make backdoor circuits small enough to find and ablate
events.summary: TopKLoRA activates only the k largest adapter latents per token and is trained on downstream loss alone. On a sleeper-agent backdoor in gemma-2-2b, Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-7B, the authors find necessary-and-sufficient circuits up to an or…

events.headline: On-policy self-training improves LLMs using only coarse topic descriptions
events.summary: The paper recasts on-policy self-distillation as self-training: guided only by high-level topic descriptions, the model generates its own queries and privileged reasoning traces and trains on them. The authors report gains across multiple…

events.headline: NgramRL speeds up RL rollouts with per-prompt n-gram speculative decoding
events.summary: Rollout generation can take over 70% of RL post-training time. NgramRL builds a drafter from recent rollouts for the same prompt, with no auxiliary model, and reports 3.60 to 7.77 tokens committed per target-model forward in the warm-cache…

events.headline: LLM vulnerability auditors defer more to false assurances than to false alarms
events.summary: Across 916 function pairs from PrimeVul, eleven model configurations and 16,572 audits, true static-analysis evidence improved accuracy by only about 0.02, while fabricated assurances that a check exists cut detection of real vulnerabiliti…

events.headline: First fully polynomial-time algorithm for learning positive sums of ReLUs under Gaussian inputs
events.summary: For PAC learning of positive linear combinations of k arbitrary ReLUs on R^d under Gaussian inputs and L2 loss, the authors give an algorithm using poly(d, k, 1/ε) samples and time, which they describe as the first fully polynomial one. Ea…

events.headline: Pixel diffusion transformers get an adaptive parameterization and a high-frequency fix
events.summary: MFlow learns to interpolate between clean-image and velocity prediction, with larger models preferring velocity. A frozen-backbone ConvRefiner trained adversarially restores the high-frequency statistics that pixel diffusion transformers l…

events.headline: LLMs recognize same-trial papers but still over-credit them as independent evidence
events.summary: In 14 clinical families, GPT-5.5 reliably identified independent updates yet over-credited same-trial reports when aggregating; some other models showed a similar gap. A study-grouping instruction eliminated the over-crediting for GPT-5.5…

events.headline: Higher acceptance in lossy speculative decoding does not mean faster decoding
events.summary: Across twelve target-drafter pairs, the most relaxed settings averaged about 1.34× more accepted tokens per round but about 1.54× longer completions, mostly from longer reasoning traces. Rules that cut verifier rounds often lowered accurac…

events.headline: Distillation traces built around the student, not just the answer
events.summary: ReDiST builds student-specific reasoning traces by revising correct drafts and repairing incorrect ones, scoring candidates with a frozen student-matched reader. It reports gains on QA benchmarks over answer-only and original-trace baselin…

events.headline: DLite drafts without history to keep speculative decoding fast for agents
events.summary: The authors report that agentic workloads can cut existing draft models' acceptance length by up to 80%. DLite reuses target-model hidden states and predicts locally without tracking full history, reporting up to 70% improvement over DSpar…

events.headline: A Gaussian picture of how wide networks begin to specialize
